uuid_resolution.rationale: 03 §4.5 / 03 line 854 freezes client.client.client_id as uuid; 12_… §4.10 deviation 1
uuid_resolution.logical_key: client_id (text, projector-visible registry key, e.g. cl_wong_001) — used by all flat-file FKs
uuid_resolution.derivation: splitmix64(20261105, '<client_id>'): mix each key byte into the seed via splitmix64, take a=that digest, b=splitmix64(a ^ 0xD1B54A32D192ED03), build a 128-bit int ((a<<64)|b), set version 4 bits (76..79) and RFC4122 variant bits (62..63), then format via uuid.UUID(int=...)
uuid_resolution.validation: every client_id_uuid is a valid uuid, unique per client, and 1:1 between clients.csv and crm_contacts.csv

idempotency_rule.why: one immutable appr_001 produces six accepted writes; without mapping_id all six collapse into one UNIQUE key (12_… §4.10 deviation 2)

canonical_filename_map.authority: 14_… §5 E-16 / 12_… §10.2 Naming scope (clarification) / 03_… §7.4 / lead ruling E-16
canonical_filename_map.scope: the 51 files declared by the READ-ONLY manifest v1.3 (the 8 frozen schemas); file_fdw foreign tables and the G5 EXCEPT check are bound to those exact canonical paths
canonical_filename_map.nn_derivation_rule: NN is taken VERBATIM from the seq of the matching load_order[] entry already recorded in manifest_addendum_crm.json (mirrored in schema_contract.json.load_order[]) — that seq IS the FK-safe emission order fixed by 03 §7.4 / 12_ §10.2. NO number is invented: record schema and table, then look up seq. Parenthetical load_order qualifiers such as '(live)' / '(family packs)' are dropped from the canonical filename; the distinct NN disambiguates those pairs.
canonical_filename_map.note_on_03_example: 03 §7.4's '04_client_client.csv' is an illustrative example of the naming convention; the recorded load_order[].seq is the authoritative NN source (E-16).
canonical_filename_map.display_alias_note: The sample pack's legible names (clients.csv, graph_nodes.csv, …) are DISPLAY ALIASES. clients.csv is NEITHER additive NOR a replacement — it is the legible display alias of the frozen client.client table. The future generator emits the canonical <NN>_<schema>_<table>.<ext> names; NO file is renamed and manifest v1.3 stays FROZEN / read_only / v1.3 / 51-file scope (E-16).
canonical_filename_map.additive_note: additive crm.* + vendor external-reference files use EXACTLY the names declared in manifest_addendum_crm.json.declared_files[] / related_external_reference_files[]
